boundary.object: Only a pair of explicitly mapped root names for an assigned agent cell, such as Источники and istochniki; internal names are never translated.
boundary.assignment: The typed assignment binds cell ID, owner, and exact full refs/heads/... ref. No branch prefix allowlist; codex/<name>/... is admitted when the port attests authority.
boundary.mapping: The caller supplies source root, target root, provenance, and a typed merge policy. No inferred transliteration or generic migration factory is duplicated.
boundary.merge_policy: Identical records at the same relative path are deduplicated and non-overlapping records are combined. Different records at the same path, including structural file/directory obstructions, preserve both whole roots and return unresolved without apply or success confirmation.
boundary.preserved_fields: Record path, node kind, exact file bytes or symlink-target bytes, uid, and mode are represented and compared. ACLs, xattrs, hardlinks, and other unrepresented POSIX metadata are not promised.
boundary.authority: The operator treats ownership/full-coverage fields as port attestations, not independently verified evidence. Unknown authority, partial coverage, foreign target, out-of-root entries, and source drift do not authorize apply.
excluded: No recursive rename of internal directories, files, signals, sources, or archives.
No live filesystem adapter is wired by this package.
No generic atomic live-tree apply claim.
No production/runtime activation and no F42 retry.

composition.tools_port: ПортСведенияКорнейКлетки observes both roots, persists/readbacks a pinned intent containing both exact expected inventories and policy, and delegates apply to the shared Tools migration engine.
composition.intent: Intent binds assignment, full ref, mapping and provenance, merge policy, exact source snapshot, optional exact target snapshot, modeled-field digests, and deterministic expected target records.
composition.reducer: Reducer intention/sent facts carry intent ID, both input digests, and mapping provenance. Effect confirmation is added only after a fresh complete post-observation proves source absent, target exact, and stored intent unchanged; observed source/target digests and generation are retained in the reducer fact.
composition.unknown: Any exception after apply begins is UNKNOWN until a fresh observation is read. A later invocation compares both roots to the pinned intent; it never repeats apply blindly. Changed target is a conflict, not confirmation.
composition.continuation: The normalized snapshot is returned to the caller as continuation state. The shared runtime has not been wired to execute that continuation by this source-only change.

fixture.type: Authored Swift Testing fixture injects an in-memory port that models the two-root Tools effect; fixture source is not a live adapter.
fixture.payload: Nested Cyrillic paths, exact signal/address JSON bytes, binary bytes, symlink target bytes, uid, and distinct modes.
cases_authored: Same-path identical directory record is deduplicated while non-overlapping source and destination records are combined.
Different same-path versions preserve both roots and return unresolved without durable intent, apply, or reducer confirmation.
File-versus-descendant structural obstruction preserves both roots and reports the blocking ancestor path.
Second invocation after successful observation is no-op and leaves reducer snapshot unchanged.
Post-effect observation failure returns UNKNOWN; later observation can confirm only the exact pinned target without another apply.
Modified target after UNKNOWN cannot confirm the stored intent.
Missing owner/ref attestation on exact post-readback inventory remains UNKNOWN and does not confirm reducer effect.
Foreign owner/ref target, incomplete scope, invalid @{-style ref, and .lock ref do not apply.
Reducer budget is preflighted before durable intent; primary plan and waiting signal remain present.
fixture.limitations: The test port models the intended contract and does not establish OS crash durability, no-follow behavior, full enumeration, concurrency safety, or filesystem atomicity.

integration_dependency.observer_boundary: КонтейнерНаблюдений.НаблюдениеФайловойСистемы observes only top-level files/links in a temporary root and does not enumerate directory cells. It is not expanded or connected here.

required_tools_contract.input: Exact assigned cell identity (cell ID, owner, full branch ref), explicit root pair and mapping provenance, explicit policy, and complete expected snapshots of both roots.
required_tools_contract.apply: Shared Tools engine persists intent, revalidates assignment and both input generations/digests, safely deduplicates only byte/type/uid/mode-identical records, moves non-overlapping records without altering relative names or link targets, and preserves both roots on unresolved collisions.
required_tools_contract.outcome: Typed observed-complete, unresolved-preserved, or UNKNOWN outcome; any possible effect requires fresh full observation and exact pinned-intent comparison before reducer confirmation. No exception means no-effect assumption.
required_tools_contract.runtime: The shared agent runtime must call this FUMA semantic operator through the Tools-owned adapter. Source-only changes do not prove or activate that wiring.

verification.static_review: Two independent read-only reviews; latest confirmed prior P1/P2 fixes with no new critical findings.

result: Source-only typed semantics and fixture received independent read-only review. Port attestation does not independently prove full inventory. Commit and exact push are the current checkpoint; integration, runtime acceptance, and production remain unclaimed.
